target: Phase 002D-R2 prospective cost and complexity policy

findings.claim: The retain-scaffold baseline is assigned a falsification condition requiring the frozen baseline-relative effectiveness formula, while that formula requires candidate-baseline improvement >=0.10. Applied literally, the baseline cannot exceed itself and the simplest fallback is always falsified; selection_rule is null.
findings.recommended_test: Evaluate the threshold engine with only ARCH-S0 and with all nonbaseline arms failing; ARCH-S0 must remain the comparator/fallback and must not be tested for improvement over itself.

findings.claim: Retry policy authorizes ceil(main starts*0.25), including 6 retries for 24 main starts, but the acceptance threshold requires retry_burden<=0.10 without defining denominator or rounding. A policy-compliant retry schedule can therefore be threshold-ineligible.
findings.recommended_test: Replay main-start counts 1 through 24 with every authorized retry count; compute one frozen retry-burden denominator and prove authorization, threshold and 30-start cap never contradict.

findings.claim: Token, retry, code-surface and maintenance limits are marked compensatory, but no decision_rule, selection_rule, utility formula or compensation ceiling exists. Effectiveness could silently compensate arbitrary cost, or different implementations could reject the same metric vector.
findings.recommended_test: Feed identical synthetic vectors where one cost cap alone fails and permute metric order; require one invariant result under an explicit frozen noncompensatory rule or bounded utility formula.

findings.claim: tracked_code_surface<=24 and maintenance_score<=24 lack units, inclusion rules and scoring formulas. The candidate descriptions enumerate files, kernels, prompts, validators, tests, reason codes and migration adapters only as prose, so surface can be reduced by file merging or omission from accounting.
findings.recommended_test: Score equivalent fixtures under file split/merge, rename and generated-code changes; require invariant totals and mandatory inclusion of runtime code, contracts, prompts, adapters, tests and maintained configuration.

findings.claim: The budget caps only model starts and retries. Stage 1 has seven ablation arms and Stage 2 may add two ablations, yet deterministic case executions, transformations, grader work, artifact retention, wall time, storage and engineering surface have no global caps.
findings.recommended_test: Expand every frozen arm, case, repeat, transformation, ablation and retained failed artifact into a resource ledger; reject launch unless starts, executions, wall time, storage and maintenance work each fit frozen caps.

findings.claim: Stop conditions cover hard failures, missing evidence and start exhaustion but not observed token, surface, maintenance or retry-cap breach, nor strict cost dominance by a simpler eligible alternative. Work may continue after an arm is already cost-ineligible.
findings.recommended_test: Inject a prospective arm that exceeds each cost cap and another with identical hard-gate/effectiveness evidence but strictly lower frozen costs; require immediate stop for the exceeded arm and deterministic dominance handling without votes.

proposed_rules: ARCH-S0 is exempt from candidate-over-baseline improvement and remains the fallback when no nonbaseline arm qualifies; no architecture is selected by this audit.
Freeze one retry_burden definition, denominator and rounding rule, then make retry authorization, acceptance threshold and absolute cap algebraically consistent for every possible main-start count.
Cost is not implicitly compensable: either mark each cap noncompensatory or freeze a bounded utility formula, weights and maximum compensation before execution.

Define tracked surface and maintenance score from a versioned manifest covering runtime code, contracts, prompts, validators, adapters, tests, configuration and retained artifacts; scoring must be invariant to file layout.
Budget every planned arm, ablation, case, repeat, transformation, retry, grader action, wall-time unit and stored artifact; unknown cost yields abstention, not zero.

Stop before further work when any frozen cost cap is irreversibly exceeded; reject strict cost dominance by a simpler eligible alternative unless a predeclared non-cost benefit is measurably superior.
abstentions: No candidate cost, effectiveness, runtime or maintenance results were available or assessed; no architecture ranking or selection is made.
